en.answer:
The activation of the effect of <<9455>> is negated, but the <<9455>> that is no longer in the location where the effect was activated (it was sent to the Graveyard as the cost to activate the effect in the hand) is not banished and remains in the Graveyard.

This is the same if any of the following effects are activated in a chain to the activation of the effect of <<9455>>:
● <<16228>>
● <<11707>>
● <<12849>>
● <<15851>>
● <<15593>>
● <<13878>>
● <<13203>>
● <<15775>>
● <<12106>>
● <<14324>>
● <<9547>>
en.question: If I activate the『When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 of your Link Monsters this card points to; negate the activation, and if you do, banish that card』effect of <<21188>> in a chain when my opponent activated the『(Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard; this turn, each time your opponent Special Summons a monster(s), immediately draw 1 card』effect of <<9455>>, what happens?
en.title: If the effect of <<21188>> is activated in a chain to the effect of <<9455>>, what happens?
